submitPR.title: Publish Plugin to OpenSquad Market
submitPR.step3Title: Submit an Issue to Request Publication
submitPR.step1Desc: Maintain your plugin code in your own public GitHub repository — no need to fork the official repo. It can be a dedicated plugin repo or a subdirectory in an existing project.
submitPR.step2Desc: Ensure your repository (or plugin subdirectory) contains the following files:
submitPR.step3Desc: Go to the opensquad-ai/opensquad-plugins repository, create a new Issue, choose the "Plugin Submission" template, and fill in the plugin name, description, and your repository link.
submitPR.step4Desc: After a maintainer reviews your Issue and plugin code, the plugin info will be synced to the OpenSquad market and will appear within minutes.
submitPR.infoText: Plugin code must extend the Plugin base class and use the @register decorator. Maintainers will review code security — plugins with dangerous system calls will be rejected.
submitPR.filesNeeded: The directory must contain these files:
submitPR.pluginPyDesc: plugin.py — Plugin code (extend Plugin class, use @register decorator)
